environment_and_protocol.clang:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
environment_and_protocol.timing: os.posix_spawn + time.perf_counter; wait4 per-process peak ru_maxrss (bytes on macOS)
environment_and_protocol.micro_protocol: 1 warmup pair + 9 alternating process pairs; no concurrent build/test benchmark; same Release compiler flags
environment_and_protocol.time_admission: median paired wall ratio < 0.98, bootstrap 95% upper < 1; at least 9 pairs and both run-time medians >=0.5 sec; check representative workload regressions; smoke/calibration runs are not admission evidence
environment_and_protocol.memory_admission: Both median and maximum of per-process peak RSS must not exceed their respective baseline statistic plus max(256 KiB, 1% of that baseline statistic); report raw per-run values, separate median/max gates, and inspect repeatable changes. This is empirical nonincrease within a measurement-noise allowance, not a proof of literally zero extra RAM for every input.
environment_and_protocol.output_admission: Differential full observable matrix/traceback results and full end-to-end VCF/JSON/compressed BAM bytes; SHA256 and explicit chunk-by-chunk file comparison, no record-order normalization
